author: Sega Jenesis
title: Commissioning full illustrated Pokémon scenes for custom card binders
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 Contact via reply or DM.
